mechanism_review.graph: For each unique true-supported fine path, a/b/c are original fine/middle/coarse LayerNorm outputs. One shared 2C->C/GELU cell performs two batched stages: first [a,b]/[a,c], then [T(a,b),c]/[T(a,c),b]. q is the two final halves difference. Fine receives q; middle/coarse each directly mean the same q over fine paths using original IDs.
mechanism_review.distinct_from_APF: Bounded actual APF source read: one 3C->3C/GELU and three independently learned output slices. AOC has depth-two weight sharing, ancestor-order contrast and one coupled q for all three destinations. Same input support/fixed private means place it in the ancestry-path family, but they do not make these DAGs equivalent.
mechanism_review.distinct_from_AEF: Bounded actual AEF source read: two orientations of same-parent MST edges and opposite signed endpoint incidence. AOC composes fine/middle/coarse ancestry orders and has no MST, endpoint incidence or unweighted flux conservation claim.
mechanism_review.other_nearby_scope: Known PES persistent node-state walk and DCE per-recipient cavity-message graphs are different from this private two-branch ancestor composition. No claim of general novelty, new input information or diagnosis of a baseline bottleneck.
mechanism_review.ban_boundary: No new QKV/attention, learned pooling weights, selector, point-quadratic routing, gate, extra residual, additional instance injection or numeric sweep in the actual delta path. Original raw means/FPS/membership and HCG gate remain the previously defined original modules.
mechanism_review.old_failure_boundary: No APF DataLoader dtype repair/restart, old held/rejected control retest, RSTR conservation claim or altered authorization follows from this candidate.

descriptive_degeneracies_and_limits: Equal normalized middle/coarse ancestors give zero q; signed parent means can cancel. Individual rows/calls/branches/blocks/bias may be zero.
If T is affine, q loses dependence on fine a. Nonlinear architecture permits a-dependent interaction but neither guarantees it is learned nor warrants a new Jacobian/fine-dependence admission gate.
Swap antisymmetry and equal-ancestor zero are algebraic normalized-input properties and scalar software controls, not FP32 identities or whole-model scale-permutation invariance.
All three outputs share q and its direct means: this intentionally restricts the independent output roles available to APF. Usefulness, gradients and scale balance remain unknown.
Original ancestor raw features already contain descendant information; no physical self-exclusion or new-information claim.

Source estimates are not resource PASS: shared cell has 131328 parameters at C256 and 4F rows; CPU metadata/unsupported operations and actual whole-call timing must remain in the original measurement scope.
